quote: Mark has made a huge impact on our 1880s Victorian home, with a full demolition of the old plaster and all new and straight walls, ceiling, cornice and ceiling roses to bring our home back to better than original. His keen eye for detail and experience allowed Mark to quickly guide us to the right selection of ceiling roses and cornice to match our age of the house. In the modern extension Mark used the latest plastering techniques to create a perfect and seamless finish and contemporary detail customised for our needs. He truly is a perfectionist with great skills and is fast and friendly. I highly recommend Mark and happily recommend him to everyone I meet.
name: Doug and Nicole
